text.p: Iberia has agreed to continue direct flights from Palma de Mallorca to London, Frankfurt and Paris, instead of suspending them as planned, a spokeswoman for the Spanish state-owned airline said.
Iberia previously said that the routes are uneconomical because load factors are high in summer but low in winter.
But its decision to suspend the services from this month caused an outcry from the Balearic island's tourist industry.
The reversal was agreed at a meeting on Tuesday between Iberia's chairman, the secretary of state for tourism and the regional tourism councillor.
Iberia has agreed to maintain the flights until March, while it looks for an alternative solution, the spokeswoman said.
